notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.14 now live!
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.14 now live!

Warrior card changes:

Chomp removed.

Replaced by Divine Blade (card effects are the same). 

Sanguine Slash effect changed. No longer stores previously dealt damage as bonus damage, now increases damage by 1 whenever healed in combat.

Missing tooltips added on all Warrior cards.

Bug fixed:

Main Menu button will now work after winning a run.

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.13 now live!
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.13 is now live!

 Artifacts are now published to the wiki page
 Added Disintegrate
 Added Past In Flames
 Added Fiend Fire
 Burning/stoke damage is now indicated on the character health bar
 IMPORTANT: There are some changes to the save game format - if you have unfinished run from previous patch version # and find the game crashes, please 'Abandon' the run from main menu and start a new one.

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.12 now live!
notes.content:
Patch 0.0.12 is now live!

Summary of changes:

Additional Monk specific artifacts added to the game.
Bug fix - piercing damage now correctly applies hit effects such as Coated Blades and Burning Blades.
Hail Of Blades adjusted to deal piercing damage.

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.11 now live!
notes.content:
Patch 0.0.11 is now live!

New features include:

Ability to toggle between combo and non-combo effects on Monk combo cards
New tip/tutorial notifications
Revised world view and added legend


Numerous minor bug fixes, including:

Preordain now correctly grants flat shield, and no longer reduces the cost of unplayable cards such as traps
Fixed a bug where scryed effect of Glimmerstone always triggered if it was present when scrying
Card rewards and shops now correctly contain card subsets once the player has discovered them through run events

notes.title: Patch 0.0.10 Bugfix
notes.content:
Fixed a number of bugs in the game:

Skip button did not work on Loaded Deck discovery dialogue
The wrong card set could be added on a loaded game
Visual bug where non-arcane cards could show mana costs on swap events

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.10 now live!
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.10 is now live!

 Settings can now be customised from the main menu as well as in game
 Settings now has options for resolutions as well as full screen - let us know in the community discussions if any issues


Bug/interaction fixes:

 Fixed game breaking null PulseTracker on loaded game (occured after effects from Creative Pulse, Expressive Pulse or Violent Pulse triggered)
 Upgrade text and upgrade pip icons refresh on deck viewer after a card has been upgraded at a bonfire or event
Mischievous Blade no longer procs Mana Ball

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.9 now live!
notes.content:
Patch 0.0.9 features the following highlights - enjoy and as always please report any suspected bugs in our community page:

 Save/load game
 Additional content
 Win streak tracking

notes.title: Fall Of The Son - Patch 0.0.8
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son Patch 0.0.8 is now live.

This patch features a huge range of updates, including new functionality such as gold rewards and shops to spend your gold on cards or powerful artifacts. The bonfire system has also been reworked to use a new resource called Kindling, this allows you to potentially use multiple options at a bonfire or a mixture as Kindling can now drop as a combat reward.

The game route has also been adjusted, with a guaranteed bonfire now occuring before the final boss. There are also minor balance changes, as well as a number of bug fixes.

notes.title: Chemical Arrow bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where Chemical Arrow would cause the game to freeze if the recurrence effect triggered when the player hand was full. The card will now be added to the discard pile if the hand is full.

notes.title: Fall Of The Son Patch 0.0.1
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son
Patch 0.0.1

Welcome to our first patch of the early access period. In this patch we look to address some of the feedback from players. We have also now made the draw pile show in a randomised order, as technically this is closed information. To compensate, the player starting health is buffed in non-survival runs and the Eternal Heart artifact is buffed in survival mode. Read the full details of the patch below:

Balance

Cards in the draw pile are now shown in a randomised order
Player starting health 50 -> 55
Surival mode: Eternal Heart now grants 1 hp per enemy defeated in each battle (previously 1 hp per battle)


Content

1 new random event added


Interface

Events that grant cards now have popups to show what the card is when the card name is hovered over in the option

notes.title: Fall Of The Son Release
notes.content:
Fall Of The Son        
Store page

        
Fall Of The Son is a roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble powerful strategies to battle through hordes of enemies - with 3 playable characters and over 200 unique cards at your disposal. Do you have the grit and determination to make it to the end and face off against The Son?

Classes
WarriorRogueWizard 

Roguelike 
Features a random map and enemy selection during each run. This will consist of battles, rest points and random events. Your progress is lost upon death.

Deckbuilder
Select a new card to add to your deck at the end of each combat. Gain access to additional cards and strategies during random events.

Additional modifiers
Survival - for a truly hardcore experienceRandom/upgraded deck - for a more casual/chaotic experience
     
Wiki   
You can view the full card pool on the wiki page.
